title: Stacking rings on the gilder's cushion

tokens.v: The three bands lie in the suede nap of a gilder's cushion beside a torn book of loose gold leaf; one leaf has lifted on a draught and buckles mid-air into a bright crumpled ribbon, its edge already tearing, throwing a moving warm bounce across the brushed rose-gold band. Red bole shows through where earlier leaf was skived, and an agate burnisher lies across the corner with the hammered white-gold band propped on end against it so its interior wall faces the lens. 100mm macro at f/4, framed 1:1 life-size, camera level with the cushion under one soft north window from camera-left at mid-morning, the lifted leaf the only thing in the frame that is moving. Inside that propped band the HOLLOWAY maker's punch is struck unlettered - a single pressed dome, no letterforms - pooling one bead of shadow; the three bands together fill roughly half the frame width. Torn leaf fragments blur across the bottom-left corner, cut by both edges.
